title: Closed-support amplitude
statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a
closed immersion, with open
complement $j$, and let $A$ be finite. Suppose that
direct image on the etale sites
satisfies $R^qj_*M=0$ for every module sheaf $M$ and every
$q>c$, where $c\geq0$. Then, in the
ordinary derived categories,

$$
Ri^!D^{[a,b]}(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)
\subseteq D^{[a,b+c+1]}(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A).
$$

If additionally every $R^qj_*F$ is
constructible for
constructible $F$, the same assertion holds with constructible
cohomology on both sides.

proof.text: Put $U=T\setminus Z$ and take $K\in D^{[a,b]}(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. The coefficient convention in the cited derived-category definition is a finite commutative ring $A$. For every scheme morphism $u$, constant-coefficient module inverse image $u^*$ is exact by [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Consequently [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology] gives $\mathcal H^n(u^*K)\cong u^*\mathcal H^n(K)$. In particular $j^*K$ has cohomology only in $[a,b]$.

source.place: Proof paragraph 1, the bounds on q; Stacks 04JC and 010N (their cited DAG statements).

proof.text: We will also use the following direct verification of constructibility under inverse image, both for $u=j$ and for $u=i$. Choose the finite constructible locally closed stratification and the etale trivializing covers with finite constant module values $M_{k,\alpha}$ of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Base change gives a stratification by [lemma-constructible-pullback-stratification]; its strata remain constructible by [lem-pur-scheme-constructible-preimage]. Pull back each trivializing cover; [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-base-change] says that the resulting families are still etale and jointly surjective. Then [lemma-constructible-pullback-constant], applied with coefficient category $\operatorname{Mod}(A)$, identifies each restricted pullback with the constant module sheaf of the same finite module $M_{k,\alpha}$. Thus the displayed data satisfy precisely the same definition on the source of $u$. This proves that $u^*$ preserves module-constructible sheaves without a Noetherian, finite-type or quasi-compactness assumption on $u$.

source.place: Proof paragraph 2, last sentence, expanded and also applied to j; Stacks 054I and the finite-stratification definition (095E). Base change of the trivializing covers: Stacks 02GO (lemma-base-change-etale) and 01S1 (lemma-base-change-surjective).

proof.text: The categories $\operatorname{Mod}(U_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ are Grothendieck abelian by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-grothendieck-abelian], and $j_*$ is additive left exact by [lem-weil-pbc-module-direct-image-left-exact]. They have enough injectives by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-enough-injectives]. By [lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative], $j^*K$ has a bounded below representative by injectives, which is K-injective. The same representative therefore computes $Rj_*$ in the ordinary derived category and in its bounded below subcategory. Apply [thm-sp-truncation-e2] to $v=j_*$ and this bounded below object: it supplies the convergent spectral sequence $E_2^{p,q}=R^pj_*\mathcal H^q(j^*K)\Rightarrow\mathcal H^{p+q}(L)$, where $L=Rj_*j^*K$, and a finite exhaustive separated filtration of every abutment with graded pieces $E_\infty^{p,n-p}$. Its $E_2$ page vanishes unless $0\leq p\leq c$ and $a\leq q\leq b$, by the hypothesis and step 1. Every later page is obtained as kernels modulo images, so zero entries stay zero. For $n<a$ or $n>b+c$ every graded piece is zero. Starting at the zero end of the finite filtration, successive zero graded quotients force each filtration term, hence its abutment, to be zero. Thus $L\in D^{[a,b+c]}(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$.

source.place: Proof paragraph 1, hypercohomology spectral sequence and its abutment bounds; generic convergence is the full statement of thm-sp-truncation-e2.

proof.text: Assume now the extra direct-image constructibility condition and that every $\mathcal H^q(K)$ is constructible. Step 2 makes $\mathcal H^q(j^*K)$ constructible, so every $E_2^{p,q}$ is constructible by the extra hypothesis. The kernel and cokernel clauses of [thm-constructible-serre] imply that images of maps between constructible sheaves are constructible, since $\operatorname{im}f=\ker(\operatorname{coker}f)$. They then show, by induction on the page, that every $E_r$ is constructible: $E_{r+1}$ is the cokernel of the incoming image in the outgoing kernel. The stabilization and finite filtration in step 3 identify the graded pieces of $\mathcal H^n(L)$ with constructible $E_\infty$ terms. Induction from the zero filtration term using the extension clause of the same cited theorem makes $\mathcal H^n(L)$ constructible. Only finitely many pages and filtration terms are involved in each degree.

source.place: Proof paragraph 2, finite spectral-sequence filtration and Serre closure; Stacks 03RZ, lemma-constructible-abelian, module clause.

proof.text: The exactness and left inverse needed for closed pushforward are justified on module sheaves, not taken from the proof of the adjoint-existence node. A closed immersion is finite by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-finite], and [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-direct-image-exact] says that its direct image on abelian etale sheaves is exact. The forgetful module-to-abelian-sheaf functor is faithful exact by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful]; hence it reflects exactness (the underlying homology of a complex is its homology after forgetting, and a module sheaf with zero underlying sheaf is zero). It commutes with $i_*$ by [lem-weil-pbc-module-direct-image-left-exact]. Therefore $i_*$ is exact on $A$-module sheaves. Furthermore [prop-openclosed-lowerstar-fully-faithful], applied with coefficient category $\operatorname{Mod}(A)$, gives the canonical counit isomorphism $i^*i_*M\cong M$ for every module sheaf $M$. In particular $i_*$ detects zero objects. Since $i^*$ and $i_*$ are exact, this same counit applied termwise gives $i^*i_*Q\cong Q$ on the ordinary derived categories as well.

source.place: Proof paragraph 1, exact and faithful i_*; Stacks 035C, plus the finite-direct-image exactness node and 03DA for the module transfer.

proof.text: Let $F=i_*Ri^!K$, where $Ri^!$ is the ordinary-derived right adjoint of [lem-exc-closed-ambient]. The statement of [lem-exc-closed-support-triangle] supplies the distinguished triangle $F\to K\to L\to F[1]$. By [lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact] its cohomology sequence contains $\mathcal H^{n-1}(L)\to\mathcal H^n(F)\to\mathcal H^n(K)$. If $n<a$, the two outer terms vanish by step 3 and the assumption on $K$. If $n>b+c+1$, then $n-1>b+c$ and $n>b$ (here $c\geq0$), so the outer terms vanish again. Exactness forces $\mathcal H^n(F)=0$ in both cases. Thus $F$ has cohomology in $[a,b+c+1]$; in particular the extra degree is at the upper end, with cohomological shift convention $\mathcal H^n(L[-1])=\mathcal H^{n-1}(L)$.

source.place: Proof paragraph 1, supported localization triangle and long exact sequence; Stacks 05RS and 0147 for the latter.

proof.text: Exactness of $i_*$ from step 5 and [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology] identify $\mathcal H^n(F)\cong i_*\mathcal H^n(Ri^!K)$. Applying the left inverse $i^*$ of step 5 to the zero sheaves outside $[a,b+c+1]$ shows $\mathcal H^n(Ri^!K)=0$ there. This proves the asserted amplitude in the ordinary derived categories, even though $Ri^!K$ was not assumed bounded below or constructible in advance.

source.place: Proof paragraph 1, final sentence; cohomology under an exact functor is Stacks 010N.

proof.text: In the constructible case, write $u_m:\mathcal H^m(K)\to\mathcal H^m(L)$ for the map induced by the triangle. The long exact sequence of [lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact] gives $0\to\operatorname{coker}(u_{n-1})\to\mathcal H^n(F)\to\ker(u_n)\to0$. Both outside terms are constructible by step 4, the hypothesis on $K$, and the kernel/cokernel clauses of [thm-constructible-serre]; its extension clause therefore makes $\mathcal H^n(F)$ constructible. By exactness of $i^*$, [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology] and the derived counit from step 5 identify $\mathcal H^n(Ri^!K)\cong i^*\mathcal H^n(F)$. Step 2 applied to $i$ makes this constructible. Together with step 7 this is exactly the second assertion, with the same interval and with the global finite-constructible-stratification notion of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes].

source.place: Proof paragraph 2, long exact sequence and exact inverse image to Z, with the kernel-extension calculation written out; Stacks 03RZ and 010N.
